scope: First automated production Function deployment and limited live regression checks. No credentials, configured owner ID, email addresses, cookies, tokens, or message contents retained.

package.extractionVerification: Passed in Linux CI before deployment

deployment.authentication: GitHub OIDC with dedicated app-scoped deployment identity

initialFailure.step: Sign in to Azure with OIDC
initialFailure.cause: Azure trusted the legacy name-only subject; GitHub issued a subject containing immutable owner/repository IDs.
initialFailure.resolution: User updated the federated credential to the exact issued main-branch subject. Rerun attempt 2 succeeded without changing application code or enabling basic authentication.

automatedChecks.probeCorrection: The original empty object was correctly rejected as verification_failed because the required empty honeypot field was absent. The corrected validation probe includes website set to an empty string; no application change was needed.

ownerInboxRefresh.evidence: User confirmed messages load correctly after refreshing the signed-in inbox following deployment.

limits: The separate-account test predates this deployment and was user-reported; it was not repeated.
Live owner-setting revocation/restoration and negative storage authorization checks remain unverified.
The permanent 5xx alert was not exercised by intentionally causing a server error.
